## Resource or correction

Explain what this teaches and which entries changed.

## Attribution and permission

Name the creator, state the license, and explain your permission to share each included component.

- [ ] This resource is free to access.
- [ ] I own it or have permission to share it.
- [ ] Creator credit and reuse terms are accurate.
- [ ] Download/instruction links work without a login or private token.
- [ ] Existing entries and stable IDs are preserved.
- [ ] No private data, paid material without permission, or executable installers are included.

Owner review is required by project policy before publication.
